about: Ninety sentences for measuring the verifier of the Desk: for each of thirty sets of passages, one sentence (or heading, or analysis sentence) that the passages support, one that says something they do not say, and one that changes what they say in a small way. The first sixty are about a made-up robot arm, the last thirty about made-up projects in AI agents and crypto. Everything in it is made up.
